rationale: The ExecSpecEq trait (trait-level) already specifies ensures tying exec_eq to deep_view equality (res == this.deep_view() =~~= other.deep_view()). Adding a duplicate, elementwise postcondition on this impl is therefore redundant and flagged as "already_specified_via_trait." The checker output also exposes unrelated harness/import/visibility issues (missing ExecSpecEq import, private seq module) that make an impl-level ensures fragile. Prefer leaving the trait-level contract as authoritative and not adding this per-impl ensures.
risks: Duplicate specification may conflict with or be ignored because the trait already provides the contract.
Vulnerability to harness/import/visibility errors (missing ExecSpecEq import; private seq module) which are unrelated to the semantic property being expressed.
The original proposal used unwrap() on get(); if a future change removes the length conjunct this could become unsound.
